about: Single source of truth for every Partner Program threshold the calculator uses. The tier table in content.md and the FAQ answers quote these numbers, so update all three together at each review. To change a threshold on a date, add a tier with effectiveFrom, set effectiveUntil on the one it replaces, and the page switches on that date.
